description:
The security team requires that the 'Payment Service' configuration be moved from hardcoded files to secure storage. 

Your task:
1. Create a new Library Variable Group named 'PaymentService-Prod'.
2. Add the following variables:
   - 'Gateway_Url': 'https://api.stripe.com/v1'
   - 'Region_Code': 'us-east-1'
   - 'Live_Secret_Key': 'sk_live_51Mz92q92929492929' (MUST be set as a locked/secret variable)
3. Update the 'azure-pipelines.yml' file in the 'main' branch of the 'TailwindTraders' repository to reference this group. Add 'group: PaymentService-Prod' to the variables section.

Start by navigating to Pipelines > Library.
